SELECT: Reversible prefix tree; each prefix beyond first address bit is computed with RCCX and uncomputed with its exact inverse around data-CX and descendant blocks. This explicitly restores relative phases. For M>=2 addresses, exact component construction uses4M−8 RCCX;4T each. M1/2 need no T. This is an implemented conservative SELECT, not the best paper4N asymptotic constant.

lambda_rule: For each table separately choose power-of-two lambda<=N minimizing16max(N/lambda−2,0)+7*b*(lambda−1), tie smallerlambda. Choice depends only on dimensions/precision before measured outcomes.
